name: Kusanagi weapon readability revision
reference: User Kusanagi illustration; extracted unchanged from Downloads/art.zip
prompt: Create a NEW production game sprite of Kusanagi, using the attached illustration only for its gold/ivory, blue jewel and white-blue-red wrapped grip design. NOT an illustration: draw pixel art for a 64 by 16 pixel inventory/equipped sprite, displayed at very large nearest-neighbor enlargement so every pixel is a BIG SOLID SQUARE. One sword centered on transparent background, horizontal, short handle LEFT and point RIGHT. All shapes must occupy a regular coarse grid. At native resolution the weapon is 59 pixels long: grip12, guard3, blade44. Blade is gently curved with near-parallel edges 6 pixels apart and a short oblique Japanese katana point in the last5pixels. NO bulging scimitar belly, NO long upswept hook. Upper spine and lower cutting edge mostly parallel and almost horizontal. Compact flat ovalgoldguard 10pixels tall, blue collarjewel2x2pixels, white/paleblue handle wrapping with three red diamond marks. The blade face is pale ivory and soft amber with a darker ochre spine and a restrained thin warmwhite lower edge. A single small gold rune close to collar, do NOT cover the blade in noisy engraving. Darkbrown single-pixel outline makes silhouette readable. 16-20 flat colors, clean hard-edged pixel clusters. Native blade has roughly six rows: outline, shadow, three face/highlight rows, cutting edge; no dithering, microtexture or blurred antialiasing. Match classic RO-style shaded pixel art. Do not reproduce illustration's glow, sparks, background, perspective, diagonal placement, long twohanded grip or reflective water. This is a single clean short one-handed katana sprite on genuinely transparent alpha0 canvas, no other objects, text, labels, grid or multiple views.
refinement_prompt: Precise game sprite geometry edit. Keep the exact canvas size and ALL HANDLE/GUARD/JEWEL pixels of this Kusanagi sprite. Keep blade length, gentle katana curve, existing colors and small gold symbol. Change only the blade thickness: it currently becomes only FOUR pixels thick at 60-pixel game resolution; make it SIX pixels thick instead. Increase the vertical thickness of the exposed blade by fifty percent, extending the LOWER cutting edge DOWNWARD by about64 imagepixels across the full main blade length. Keep the upper spine in place and the tip position fixed, taper to the point in the last160imagepixels only. Use the added space for a broad calm PALE GOLD/IVORY metal face, not for thick dark borders. Keep existing dark contour, thin ivory edge and narrow ochre spine. Maintain the existing coarse pixel blocks and single small rune, with crisp flat clustered shading and no added microdetail. No changes to the hilt, point position, blade length or composition. No glow, no sparks, no new text. Preserve genuine transparent alpha background. The whole blade should read as a slightly fuller KATANA with nearly parallel edges and a short angled point, not a scimitar or axe.
source_pixels: Original generated RGBA image copied unchanged. Native sprite samples and packing use compile_weapons.py.
